suggested.hi: संसार / शिव / हो, बनो (भू का लोट् मध्यम पुरुष एकवचन)
suggested.en: worldly existence / Shiva / be (imperative of bhū)

reason: In शरणं भव it is the imperative 'be (my refuge)'; the entry lacks that sense and its grammar.

current: पुराणोंमें वर्णित पुरुषोत्तम | the Supreme Person of the Purāṇas

suggested.en: the primeval Supreme Person / the Supreme Person of the Purāṇas

reason: MW: पुराणपुरुष 'primeval male', a name of Viṣṇu; पुराण as an adjective means 'ancient'. The primary sense is missing.

current: दोनों जाँघें (ऊपरी भाग) | the two upper thighs

suggested.en: the two upper thighs / the thigh-bones

reason: MW: 'the thigh, thigh-bone'; Apte adds 'a bone'. The kavaca names ऊरू (thighs) separately, so the bone sense is needed.

current: मनको रमानेवाले (राम)में | in the heart-delighting one

suggested.en: in the heart-delighting one / O charming one (vocative of मनोरमा)

reason: Also read as a vocative addressing Pārvatī; see the doubts file.
The Hindi has the genitive हमारे but the English lacks 'our', the sense this verse needs (स नः प्रभुः 'our Lord').
Here it may be adverbial with कूजन्तम् ('warbling sweetly').
